subject: general
question: Which Constitutional Amendment introduced the Goods and Services Tax (GST) in India?

options.text: One Hundred and First Amendment Act, 2016
One Hundred and Second Amendment Act, 2018

solution: The correct answer is __**One Hundred and First Amendment Act, 2016**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Goods and Services Tax (GST)** was introduced in India through the **One Hundred and First Amendment Act of the Constitution**, which was enacted in the year **2016**. • The GST was implemented on **July 1, 2017**, marking a significant reform in India’s indirect taxation system. • This amendment added **Article 246A** to the Constitution, granting exclusive powers to both the Union and State Governments to legislate on GST. • It replaced various indirect taxes such as **Central Excise Duty**, **Service Tax**, **Value Added Tax (VAT)**, and other indirect taxes. • Under GST, goods and services are taxed under a single comprehensive tax structure, divided into **CGST (Central Goods and Services Tax)**, **SGST (State Goods and Services Tax)**, and **IGST (Integrated Goods and Services Tax)**.
